//: tsx transpile settings for tests/web-leads-automations-catalogue.render.ts ONLY. The root tsconfig sets jsx:"preserve" because Next does its own JSX transform; tsx honours that and falls back to the CLASSIC runtime, so a .tsx component renders as `React.createElement` with no React in scope and throws `React is not defined`. This file overrides jsx for that one spawned process and is passed via TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH. It changes nothing about the build, the typecheck or any other test.
